31/S0.subgoal: Explain how the human somatosensory system uses receptors and neural signals to perceive touch, proprioception, and kinesthesis.

31/S1.subgoal: Describe how haptic perception and haptic exploration support object-property perception and can increase immersion in XR.

31/S2.subgoal: Describe how touch or haptic feedback can be provided in XR through force-feedback devices and tangible user interfaces.

31/S3.subgoal: Describe how smell and taste, as chemical senses, can be simulated in XR and why such interfaces are less developed and technically challenging.

31/S4.subgoal: Summarize the lecture's main points and preview the next lecture on building interactive XR systems.
